title: Lost Mary Gami 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Gami by Lost Mary Nic Salt is a playful and fruity confectionery-inspired blend. It captures the sweet, chewy, and nostalgic taste of mixed-fruit chewy sweets, delivering a fun and flavourful vape that's bursting with bright, sugary notes. Lost Mary Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same intense and popular flavours the brand is famous for. This 10ml e-liquid collection is perfect for vapers seeking a reliable, flavour-packed experience in a refillable format. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It produces a discreet amount of vapour and carries flavour exceptionally well. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit, even at higher strengths, providing satisfying and rapid nicotine relief. Lost Mary Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, making them a versatile choice for a wide range of vapers. They are ideal for use in low-wattage pod vape kits and starter vape kits. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant, featuring a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety.
